title: Office Corridor and Management Office Door Condition
prompt:
1) Function: Capture a forensic-quality documentary photo of an office corridor focusing on the condition of a management office door and surrounding frame.

2) Scene / Composition: A neutral office corridor with plain painted drywall, low-pile commercial carpet, and a single closed interior door centered in frame, with the door and frame occupying ~55% of the image. The door is unbranded, solid-core style with a generic lever handle; no readable room names or personal information. Show the door jamb, latch area, and hinge side clearly, with minor everyday wear (small scuffs) but no dramatic damage. Background includes a short stretch of corridor wall and baseboard on both sides for context, with no people present.

3) Angle & Distance: Eye-level perspective at angle_deg 0, camera height 1.60 m, standing 2.20 m from the door, camera aimed straight-on and level.

4) Optics & Technique: 35 mm lens, f/8, 1/125 s, ISO 200, white balance 5200K, on-camera forensic flash with even illumination; focus locked on the door latch area; deep depth of field keeping door edges and nearby wall sharp.

5) Mandatory elements (labels/markers/timestamps already present in the case): None.

6) Negatives (objective list of what MUST NOT appear): No people, faces, reflections showing a photographer, or identifying biometrics; no real names, room numbers, company branding, logos, or insignia; no official badges/credentials; no visible license plates; no timestamps, watermarks, or annotations; no evidence markers, rulers, or scale cards; no blood, weapons, or graphic violence; no readable documents on walls.

7) Acceptance checklist (objective, verifiable bullets): - Single color photograph with even flash illumination and minimal shadows
- Straight-on eye-level view of a closed interior door with surrounding frame and adjacent corridor visible
- Door occupies approximately 55% of the frame; latch area and hinges are clearly discernible
- No text labels, timestamps, annotations, logos, or personally identifying information visible
- No people present; no reflections showing a face or camera operator
- Image appears forensic-quality: sharp focus, low noise, neutral color rendering
